initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis, then the other one (a sidestep when aligned)
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: loot
initial_skills.source:
# loot(spot): get within 2 cells of spot, find residue on it or next to it, step onto it, absorb every residue there
SET dx = spot.x - here.x
SET dy = spot.y - here.y
IF dx < 0
  SET dx = 0 - dx
END
IF dy < 0
  SET dy = 0 - dy
END
SET n = dx + dy - 2
IF n > 30
  SET n = 30
END
IF n > 0
  REPEAT n
    CALL step(spot) INTO s
  END
END
SET found = null
SET pile = null
SET i = 0
REPEAT 5
  IF found == null
    SET c = (spot.x, spot.y)
    IF i == 1
      SET c = (spot.x + 1, spot.y)
    END
    IF i == 2
      SET c = (spot.x - 1, spot.y)
    END
    IF i == 3
      SET c = (spot.x, spot.y + 1)
    END
    IF i == 4
      SET c = (spot.x, spot.y - 1)
    END
    SET r = observe(c)
    IF r.ok
      FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
        IF e.kind == "residue"
          SET found = c
          SET pile = r.data.entities
        END
      END
    END
  END
  SET i = i + 1
END
IF found == null
  RETURN "no residue near spot"
END
REPEAT 4
  CALL step(found) INTO s
END
SET got = "could not reach the residue"
FOR_EACH e IN pile
  IF e.kind == "residue"
    SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
    SET b = absorb(e.id, "essence")
    IF a.ok
      SET got = "looted"
    END
  END
END
RETURN got

initial_skills.name: hunt
initial_skills.source:
# hunt(target, strike): query target; if it is within 3 cells strike at once with just enough compute
# (at most strike), else walk up to 3 steps toward it and query again; loot the body (also when someone else killed it)
IF strike < 1
  RETURN "strike must be a number of at least 1"
END
IF target == self
  RETURN "cannot hunt yourself"
END
SET last = null
REPEAT 40
  SET q = query(target)
  IF NOT q.ok
    IF last == null
      RETURN "no such fighter (or already dead)"
    END
    CALL loot(last) INTO got
    RETURN "target died; " + got
  END
  SET last = q.data.position
  SET dx = last.x - here.x
  SET dy = last.y - here.y
  IF dx < 0
    SET dx = 0 - dx
  END
  IF dy < 0
    SET dy = 0 - dy
  END
  IF dx + dy <= 3
    SET blow = q.data.health / 2 + 1
    IF blow > strike
      SET blow = strike
    END
    SET a = attack(target, blow)
    IF a.ok
      IF a.effects.killed
        CALL loot(last) INTO got
        RETURN "killed " + target + "; " + got
      END
    ELSE
      IF a.reason == "insufficient_compute"
        RETURN "too little compute to strike"
      END
    END
  ELSE
    SET n = dx + dy - 3
    IF n > 3
      SET n = 3
    END
    REPEAT n
      CALL step(last) INTO s
    END
  END
END
RETURN "still hunting; run hunt again"
